AzureAd.//ClientSecret: NEVER commit this. Set it with 'dotnet user-secrets set AzureAd:ClientSecret <value>' in development, or the environment variable AzureAd__ClientSecret in production. Prefer a certificate or managed identity over a secret.
AzureAd.//RequireAppRoles: Set true once Report.Viewer / Report.SqlAuthor app roles are assigned in Entra ID. While false, any user in the tenant who can sign in is treated as a viewer.

Sql.//AuthMode: SqlLogin | Integrated | EntraApp | EntraOnBehalfOf. See docs/03-sql-server-setup.md — the Entra modes require Azure SQL, SQL Managed Instance, or an Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server 2022+.
Sql.//UserId: Set via user-secrets or the Sql__UserId environment variable. Must be a login with db_datareader only.
Sql.//TrustServerCertificate: Set true only for an on-premises instance presenting a self-signed certificate.

Ai.//: Local inference for natural-language querying and result summaries. Runs on the LAN so DNS history never leaves the network. Endpoint is an Ollama server, e.g. http://<AI_HOST>:11434
Ai.//TimeoutSeconds: CPU-only hosts generate a few tokens per second; a question can legitimately take 30-60s.
Ai.//MaxSummaryRows: Rows considered when building the statistical digest that is narrated. The digest is computed locally, so this is cheap.

DataProtection.//KeyPath: Where to persist the data protection key ring. Set this in production - for example C:/ProgramData/PiholeReportServer/keys - so the auth cookie survives an app pool recycle and a redeploy. Leave empty in development, where the framework default is fine.
